    "Enrollment (K-12)", 
    ("FRPM Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)") * 100 AS "Eligibility Rate (%)"
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "Academic Year" = '2021-2022' AND 
    "School Type" = 'Traditional' AND 
    "District Type" = 'Traditional' AND 
    "County Code" = '059' AND 
    "District Code" = '059000' AND 
    "School Code" = '059000001' AND 
    "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND 
    "District Name" = 'Los Angeles Unified School District' AND 
    "School Name" = 'Los Angeles High School for Math, Science and Engineering'
ORDER BY 
    "Eligibility Rate (%)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

    CDSCode, 
    AvgScrWrite, 
    CharterNum
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        s.CDSCode, 
        s.AvgScrWrite, 
        sc.CharterNum,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            cds AS CDSCode, 
            AvgScrWrite
         FROM 
            satscores
         WHERE 
            AvgScrWrite > 499
         GROUP BY 
            cds, 
            AvgScrWrite) s
     JOIN 
        schools sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
     WHERE 
        sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY 
    rank;
